title: V12 CHANGED OBJECTIVE | uncapped max-min first, sum service second | seed 71669974

panels.title: V12 primary: uncapped minimum cumulative service ratio
panels.note: V12 changed the objective. s=1 is not a stopping target. A certified global interval and attained method fairness are distinct.

panels.title: Secondary service at each method's attained floor
panels.note: Each method holds its own attained s0. Compare secondary service as the same problem only when the floors are the same.

panels.title: Primary fairness versus recorded elapsed time
panels.note: Real saved checkpoints. No cap at 1, no fabricated plateau or extension after stopping.

panels.title: Total service versus time: fairness phase may reduce sum
panels.note: During stage 1 fairness has priority over total service. Stage 2 preserves the attained stage-1 floor.

panels.title: Final per-user cumulative guaranteed-service ratios
panels.referenceLabel: QoS demand reference (auxiliary, not fairness cap)
panels.note: Services are accumulated over all slots before taking user ratios. Instantaneous per-slot fairness is not the objective.

panels.title: Valid conditional throughput upper bounds at stated floors
panels.note: Conditional original-model sum-service bounds; these are not certificates for the primary max-min objective.
